name: mode-f-drain-queue
description: Drains ONE shared synthetic queue with 5 interchangeable claimants: a `parallel` over 5 self-draining `repeat` branches, each branch one `step` that invokes the queue worker exactly once. Unlike the shard drain the branches CONTEND — every branch may claim any item — so this is the definition that exercises atomic claiming, late-proposed work and heterogeneous item durations. Terminates on the queue-published `drained` flag, which is only true once ready, proposed, claimed and orphaned are ALL zero. Generated by generate.sh — edit K there.

inputs.scripts_dir: Absolute path to the harness scripts/ directory

steps.prompt:
Run exactly this one command, then stop:

python3 "{{scripts_dir}}/queue_worker.py" --root ".kiro-harness/queue" --owner branch-01

Then reply with exactly one line: exit=<the exit code of that command>

Do NOT run the command more than once. Do NOT run any other command. Do NOT read, write or edit any file yourself — the command does all of that, and a hand edit corrupts a queue that 4 other branches are claiming from concurrently.

Exit code 0 means one item was worked. Exit code 3 means the claim was empty; that is a NORMAL result, not an error, and you must still report it and stop rather than retrying.
